critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 706 lines; consider splitting tickets/channels/views/ai modules into routers under /app/backend/routes/ for maintainability before adding more features.

POST /api/public/tickets has no rate limiting or CAPTCHA - in production this is an open ticket-spam vector against any known operator email; add basic IP rate limit and optional honeypot before launch.

PUT /api/tickets/{tid} accepts the full TicketIn model and overwrites fields like channel/contact_id even when client only intended a status flip; frontend works around it by spreading {...t} but a PATCH endpoint would be safer.

/api/contacts/import has no per-request size limit and inserts contacts one-by-one (await insert_one in loop); switch to insert_many for large CSVs and add a row cap (e.g., 5000) to prevent memory/abuse issues.

Channels page hardcodes the displayed Webhook URL to /api/webhooks/{ch.id} but no such webhook endpoints exist on the backend yet - currently cosmetic only; flag for future implementation or remove the misleading hint.

Saved views filters are stored as free-form dict and only consumed client-side in Contacts.jsx; entity='deals' option exists in the model but no UI applies it - either wire it up or remove from the Literal until used.
Public ticket endpoint trusts client-provided requester_email/name with only EmailStr validation; consider sanitizing description/subject length to prevent abuse.
